$comment: Perf budgets for embedded frontend assets and the Go binary (which embeds web/ via embed.FS). Sizes are gzip bytes for JS, raw bytes for the binary. Caps sit ~15-20% above 2026-09 main so legitimate growth has room but accidental bloat (unminified vendor, new heavy dep, committed fixture) fails CI. Recalibrate quarterly or after intentional vendor bumps: run scripts/check-asset-budget.sh, verify the growth is intended, then update caps here. Files ending in .gz are stored precompressed (web/pierre, served with Content-Encoding: gzip) and are measured as stored. pierreDirBytes caps the whole web/pierre directory (entry + worker + every Shiki grammar chunk) since all of it is embedded in the binary.

files.note: largest vendor dep (~70% of shipped JS); any mermaid bump shows here
@pierre/diffs + Shiki core entry (stored precompressed; measured as stored). Grammars are separate on-demand chunks.
main review UI; catches unbounded app.js growth
review page styles; homepage/legal pages use Tailwind, not this file

globs.note: shared renderer/comment/diff modules; catches module sprawl
